Remove an end user's pin at a location, in production or in test with --env test, so they see what
it shows everyone else again.

Usage:
  voidhash location unpin [location] [person] [flags]

Arguments:
  location  The location's slug, name or id
  person    The end user: an email, a distinct id or a person id (person_…); prefix email:,
            distinct_id: or person_id: to say which

Flags:
      --env <production|test>  Whose apps the pin answers: production (the default), which answers
                               every app, or test, which answers apps using a test key only and wins
                               there
  -h, --help                   Show help for this command
      --project <project>      Project to act on: its id, slug, organization/slug or name (default:
                               this directory's project, then your default project)

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash location unpin home ada@example.com
  voidhash location unpin home distinct_id:device-qa --env test
